These unmodified proprietary runtime DLLs are redistributed for use with
SynthScan. They are not licensed under SynthScan's GPL or other open-source
licenses. No Microsoft installer is run on the user's machine.

The official download and SHA-256 are pinned in vc_runtime.json. The build
extracts only x64 minimum-runtime DLLs, used app-locally by Python and the
native application. Microsoft licensing and redistribution information:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/
